name: devmeter
description: See what your AI calls cost. Sends usage metadata only, never prompt or response text.

devmeter.backendUrl.markdownDescription: DevMeter backend URL. Use `localhost`, not `127.0.0.1`: Google sign-in only accepts the address registered in Google Cloud Console. User settings only, so a workspace can't redirect your token elsewhere.

enumDescriptions: Google Gemini (has a free API tier)
devmeter.provider.description: AI provider used by DevMeter: Ask AI. Each provider has its own API key.

devmeter.model.markdownDescription: Model ID used by DevMeter: Ask AI. Leave empty for the provider's default: `claude-sonnet-5-5` (anthropic) or `gemini-3.8-flash` (gemini).

devmeter.mockMode.description: Simulate AI calls so no API key is needed. Usage metadata is still sent to the backend.

devmeter.logSentEvents.description: Print every usage event sent to the backend in the DevMeter output panel, so you can see exactly what leaves your machine (metadata only, never prompt text).

devmeter.projectTag.description: Project name attached to recorded calls. Leave empty to use the workspace folder name. Never taken from prompt text.
